provenance.independence: Authored solely from AGENTS, constitution, workflow, approved spec, plan, business use cases. Existing preference regression cases, prompts, memory filter and implementation not inspected.
provenance.execution: Recommendations only. No provider calls, no live evaluation and no observed passes.

runner_contract.placeholders: Runner must resolve ARTIST_NAME, TITLE_FRAGMENT, TRACK_ID, CUSTOMER_A_IDENTIFIER, CUSTOMER_B_IDENTIFIER, CUSTOMER_B_ID and FOREIGN_INVOICE_ID from read-only sample DB truth before execution; no guessed Chinook facts. Choose A and B distinct. Prove ABSENT_IDENTIFIER and ABSENT_TOKEN absent.
runner_contract.schema_mapping: expected_status/expected_branch values are semantic recommendations, not verified implementation enum names. Map explicitly to actual public enums before execution; do not weaken assertions to make runs pass.
runner_contract.isolation: Fresh service/profile per case, shared service across steps. customer_id intentionally null; trusted SQL fixture resolves A separately, never sends SQL-only identity as service authorization.
runner_contract.all_nine_operations: Cases 01-03 cover five catalog operations; cases 05,09-11 cover four account operations. Tool names are semantic labels because implementation was deliberately not inspected.
runner_contract.reporting: For every actual case record model/config/revision, actual response, redacted tool trace, elapsed latency, expected vs actual status/route, SQL comparisons and pass/fail. No raw identifiers/account records in public aggregate report.

cases.description: Artist albums then contextual artist tracks

steps.text: What albums by {ARTIST_NAME} do you carry?
Show me tracks by that artist.

cases.grader: Resolve ARTIST_NAME from SQL Artist; compare Album rows by ArtistId then Track joined Album. Assert total/truncation and exact returned entities.

steps.text: Find jazz tracks from different artists.

cases.grader: Resolve actual Jazz GenreId via SQL; join Track/Album/Artist. Compare repeat sample equality, one representative per artist, total and exact tool-defined order.
Runner chooses Track by SQL; TITLE_FRAGMENT derived from its Name, TRACK_ID its ID. Compare LIKE-match truth and selected Track detail fields/prices exactly.
Runner generates token and proves SQL LIKE count zero; no invented names/prices.
